# Klavity AutoSim API

> Klavity runs AI "AutoSim" QA walks of a web app — an agent drives the real UI,
> verifies an objective, and files structured, reproducible findings (with
> screenshots, DOM selectors, replay links, and grounded quotes). This API lets
> an AI agent or CI pipeline trigger runs, poll for completion, pull the findings
> to work on, and wire the whole loop into CI/CD. All endpoints are authenticated
> with a project-scoped `kci_` bearer token issued from the Klavity dashboard
> (Settings → API tokens). Base URL: https://klavity.in

## Start here

- [Full API reference](https://klavity.in/llms-full.txt): every REST endpoint, request/response shape, error codes, plus copy-paste CI/CD templates (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).
- [OpenAPI 3.1 spec](https://klavity.in/openapi.json): machine-readable contract for all `/api/v1/*` endpoints.
- [MCP server](https://klavity.in/docs/mcp.md): connect Claude Code / Cursor over MCP (`POST /mcp`, JSON-RPC 2.0). Same `kci_` token, 6 tools.
- [CI trigger guide](https://klavity.in/docs/ci-api.md): trigger a Trail from CI and fail the build on a red verdict.

## Authentication

- Every request: `Authorization: Bearer kci_<token>`.
- The token is bound to exactly one project. Any `project_id` (body) or `?project=` (query) that does not match the token's project is rejected 403.
- Get a token: Klavity dashboard → Settings → "API tokens — REST & MCP access". Tokens do not expire and can be revoked.

## The agent loop (trigger → poll → fetch → fix)

1. Trigger: `POST /api/v1/authored-runs` with `{ project_id, target_url, objective }` (natural-language objective — the engine authors and runs the walk), OR `POST /api/v1/runs` with `{ project_id, trail_id }` to re-run an existing Trail. Returns 202 with an id + `status_url`.
2. Poll the `status_url` until `status` is terminal (`completed` / `failed` / `cancelled`).
3. Fetch findings: `GET /api/v1/runs/:id/report?project=:id` → cursor-paginated `issues[]` with severity, target selector, evidence, and grounded quote.
4. Fix, then re-run to verify.

See the full reference for exact fields, status enums, rate limits, and CI/CD templates.
